title: End of session
summary: Return the field to zero, unload the warm sample, and document the final instrument state. Placeholder content written from general laboratory practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Confirm zero field and safe access
steps.body: Ramp the field to zero at the approved rate and wait for the controller to report completion. Confirm that the sample remains at room temperature, then run the approved sample-exchange pressure cycle and wait for safe access status.
steps.check: Reported field is zero, sample temperature is stable at room temperature, and chamber pressure permits access.

steps.title: Open access and remove the puck
steps.body: Open the designated sample access and lift the access deck using the local loading procedure. Retrieve the puck with the insertion tool and place it in a labeled container.

steps.title: Close and restore the chamber
steps.body: Check that no tools or loose wires remain, then lower and secure the access deck and refit the designated cover. Run the approved empty-chamber purge and sealing cycle and confirm the required standby status while leaving cooling services running.

steps.title: Record the session
steps.body: Record the sample identifier, data location, final temperature and field, and chamber standby status. Note any faults or unusual signals and leave the bench clear for the next user.
